errors.ACCOUNT_ACCESS: The account cannot use this speech service — check that its plan and its model access are active, then try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The speech service rejected its key — check the voice provider credentials in Settings, then try again.
errors.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The speech service quota is used up — top up the account or switch to another voice provider.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many transcriptions at once — wait a moment and record again.
errors.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The transcription model is not available to this account — pick another model in the voice provider settings.
errors.AUDIO_REJECTED: The service refused this recording — record again, or upload a different audio file.
errors.CONTENT_FLAGGED: The service flagged this recording's content — check the audio and try a different clip.
errors.NO_SPEECH_DETECTED: No speech was found in the recording — record again and speak closer to the microphone.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: The speech service is not answering right now — wait a moment and try again.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: No voice provider is configured — set one up in Settings to transcribe recordings.
errors.INVALID_BASE_URL: The voice provider's base URL is not valid — correct it in the voice provider settings.
errors.OVERSIZE: The recording is too large to upload — record a shorter clip and try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MIME: This audio format is not supported — try a different file, or record with the microphone.
errors.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The local speech engine is not available on this server — check that it is installed, or choose another voice provider.
errors.unknown: The transcription failed — try again, or check the voice provider settings.
